summary_en: ¥30,000M upper limit, 3,000,000 shares (3.5% of S/O ex-treasury), ToSTNeT-3 method, acquisition window 6 Aug 2024–31 Jan 2025. Rationale: enhanced shareholder return and capital efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2024, J Trust Co., Ltd. (ticker 8508, TSE Standard) announced authorization by its Board of Directors to acquire up to 3,000,000 of its own common shares, representing 3.5% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury), at a maximum aggregate cost of ¥30,000 million. The acquisition will be conducted via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange block trading) from 6 August 2024 through 31 January 2025. The company states that the buyback aims to fulfill enhanced shareholder return and improve capital efficiency (資本効率の改善), which it identifies as a key management priority for sustained enterprise value growth. No specific price ceiling per share was disclosed in the notice.
